overview: Stroke is a leading cause of death globally, responsible for approximately 10% of total deaths. It is a noncommunicable disease and one of the top 10 causes of death worldwide. Stroke is a condition where the blood supply to the brain is interrupted, either due to a blockage or a rupture of the blood vessels in the brain.
symptoms: Sudden weakness or numbness in the face, arm, or leg
Sudden confusion or trouble speaking or understanding speech
Sudden trouble seeing in one or both eyes
Sudden severe headache with no known cause
Sudden trouble walking, dizziness, or loss of balance
key_facts: Stroke is responsible for approximately 10% of total deaths worldwide
In 2021, stroke was the third leading cause of death globally
The number of deaths from stroke has increased by 2.7 million since 2000
Stroke is a leading cause of disability worldwide
The risk of stroke increases with age
